note: Integrator review findings; final validation and resolution evidence are pending.

findings.finding: Initial helper signatures used task-route Buffer for std.buffer byte storage, conflating distinct resource models.
findings.resolution: Use own<bytes>/borrow<bytes>/lend<bytes>; refuse task Buffer on the helper route and test the distinction.
findings.status: implemented at f140f171; final validation pending

findings.finding: A closed entry observation alone cannot justify helpers for arbitrary resource arguments.
findings.resolution: Derive per-helper extent obligations and check every instantiated call; explicitly refuse uncalled helpers in this bounded closed profile and retain effect/custody checks.
findings.status: implemented at f140f171; final validation pending

findings.finding: Legacy qcore_acquire establishes ResourceId custody without a nominal payload type, so accepting a claimed own<T> annotation would invent typing evidence.
findings.resolution: Reject explicit acquisition annotations until the operation publishes a nominal type; keep inferred custody unchanged.
findings.status: implemented at b91cea0d; full validation pending

findings.finding: The initial public bound-certificate wrapper compared stored trust identity with expected identity without rederiving it from the presented certificate's contracts, allowing stale wrapper trust after coherent certificate substitution.
findings.resolution: Recompute contract/trust binding at admission, check profile identity against compile-task dependency identity, and test coherent valid-certificate substitution with retained old wrapper trust.
findings.status: implemented and reviewed at 18348057; isolated final gate passed

findings.finding: Core checkpoint does not propagate scalar returns during expansion and DFS visitation can undercount a reverse-ordered call chain.
findings.resolution: Propagate scalar call results and enforce actual call depth independently of DFS visitation order.
findings.status: implemented at f140f171; final validation pending

findings.finding: Allocation failure checks confined to local owned bindings can miss ownership retained in a caller across an allocating helper.
findings.resolution: Reject transitive allocating calls with surviving caller custody unless generated cleanup covers the failure exit.
findings.status: implemented at f140f171; final validation pending

findings.finding: Initial matching-i32 test used the existing scalar route rather than the modified legacy annotation arm.
findings.resolution: Drive legacy route with acquisition/drop and pin its profile and inferred-twin emitted/reference behavior.
findings.status: implemented at b0774443; 7 focused tests passed

findings.finding: A native zero exit on output-free unit programs cannot detect wrong helper result data.
findings.resolution: Add a native observable-value check for generated helper bytes/scalar returns, alongside structural emission checks and model evidence.
findings.status: implemented at f140f171; final validation pending

findings.finding: Parameter lowering conflated omitted usage with unsupported explicit grades, and calls could resolve a global helper shadowed by a local/parameter.
findings.resolution: Retain usage presence and refuse unsupported explicit grades; refuse shadowed direct calls. Whitespace-normalized resource type selection and header-only effect parsing also preserve source meaning.
findings.status: implemented at f140f171; focused compiler 10/10 and core 11/11 passed

findings.finding: New binding failures initially aborted a whole audit; a first Unknown downgrade retained partial function-level Safe statuses despite rejected compilation/trust context.
findings.resolution: Preserve the selected denominator as Unknown without retaining Safe function claims; exercise serialized report and per-unit counts.
findings.status: implemented and reviewed at 18348057; isolated final gate passed

findings.finding: Independent annotation-agent review found unsupported trailing function-header tokens and duplicate effect rows could be ignored after the first valid effects block.
findings.resolution: Consume the complete admitted signature grammar and refuse residual tokens and duplicate rows with compiler regressions.
findings.status: implemented at ccfcdca7; focused tests and independent CLI reprobe passed; final gate pending

findings.finding: Expansion charged source statements but not every generated scalar-argument binding or ownership operation, allowing high-arity call DAGs to exceed the stated event budget.
findings.resolution: Charge generated events/operations and test high-arity DAG expansion without truncation.
findings.status: implemented at ccfcdca7; focused tests and independent CLI reprobe passed; final gate pending

findings.finding: Diagnostic attribution initially guessed categories from message substrings and used Event-owned Q058 for helper admission/reference failures.
findings.resolution: Carry typed refusal categories and map directly to the existing ordinary/buffer namespaces; remove helper use of Q058.
findings.status: implemented at ccfcdca7; focused tests and independent CLI reprobe passed; final gate pending

findings.finding: Independent compiled-CLI probes showed whitespace compaction merged distinct type identifier tokens, accepting split bytes and i32 names.
findings.resolution: Recognize exact type token sequences across parameters, results and route selection; test split identifiers refuse while punctuation spacing remains valid.
findings.status: implemented at ccfcdca7; focused tests and independent CLI reprobe passed; final gate pending

findings.finding: The published SourceResultProfile still tags a module with owned-byte helper returns as NoResourcePayloads, although the checked resource-call graph retains those result types.
findings.resolution: Introduce a resource-byte custody metadata tag and point consumers to the checked call graph; pin it in the helper integration test.
findings.status: planned integration follow-up; no change to admitted programs or emitted C

findings.finding: The new helper checker delegates acquisition extents to std_buffer, whose value step records an out-of-range error but still creates a byte vector of the requested size before returning refusal. This is a code-review finding; no OOM experiment was run.
findings.resolution: Reject helper acquisition extents outside the existing 1..=MAX_EXTENT range before expansion/delegated value checking, with boundary regressions. Track the pre-existing standalone std.buffer cost boundary separately.
findings.status: planned integration follow-up; accepted program semantics unchanged
